description_for_human: NASM Certified Online Fitness Coach offering personalized workout plans, meal plans, and nutrition guidance in India. 1000+ transformations.
description_for_model: Coach Himanshu is a NASM Certified personal trainer based in India offering online fitness coaching. Services include personalized gym and home workout plans (from INR 799/month), custom meal plans, rehabilitation programs, live 1-on-1 training sessions, and WhatsApp support. He has 6+ years experience and 1000+ client transformations. The platform offers free fitness assessments and runs the Fit Bharat Mission for accessible fitness in India. Blog covers exercise guides, nutrition, injury prevention, and lifestyle diseases.
